reason: B offers the more controlled, low-cost intervention and directly correlates nanoscale chemistry/strain with low-field magnetocaloric behavior, whereas A extrapolates Pd behavior in a dissimilar second-order alloy to Ag, which may segregate and alter phase stability. However, B’s central prediction is physically questionable because homogenizing a distribution of local transition temperatures would normally narrow—not broaden—the transition, so the proposal should instead distinguish strain-relief effects on hysteresis from chemical-homogeneity effects on transition width.
